messages:
hana (Finance): BlueHarbor reported an unexpected pass-through line on INV-4512 for partner infra charges; they claim we billed them twice. Can billing check?
lucas-sales: AE forwarded their statement. Customer is irate about the duplicate vendor passthrough. Need a corrective ASAP.
mike-billing: Pulling invoice lines and vendor remittance. One moment.
vendor-bot: Vendor remittance file VH-2026-04- uploaded to /secure/vendor_remits/VH-2026-04.csv
mike-billing: I see two passthrough lines with identical vendor_ref and settlement_id; looks like a replay from the vendor feed on 2026-04-18.
erin-ops: We had a retry window configured for vendor webhooks; a transient 502 caused a duplicate webhook that the ingestion service accepted. We patched idempotency yesterday.
hana (Finance): Can you calculate the duplicate amount? Customer wants refund and a note they won't incur fees for dispute handling.
mike-billing: Duplicate amount = $7,425. I'll prepare a credit memo and reverse the vendor pass-through in our payable ledger.
lucas-sales: Customer also asks for a $200 goodwill credit for AE time. Recommend we include it.
hana (Finance): Proposed total credit = $7,625. Approve? Need credit memo, journal, and vendor reversal note.
mike-billing: Creating credit memo CM-845 for $7,625 and journal JE-2026-05-INV4512. Also creating vendor reversal ticket VEND-560.
erin-ops: Adding monitoring alert and fixed webhook idempotency; will sweep vendor remits 2026-04-17..2026-04-19 for similar duplicates.
vendor-bot: Created ticket VEND-560 (duplicate-remit-reversal) and attached VH-2026-04.csv
hana (Finance): Approving manual credit. @mike-billing send final customer note; lucas to review.
lucas-sales: Draft to customer: "We identified a duplicate vendor remittance that caused a passthrough line to be billed twice on INV-4512. We've issued a $7,625 credit (refund + goodwill) and reversed the vendor payable. We're sorry for the error and have fixed ingestion idempotency." I'll send after CM posts.
mike-billing: Credit memo posted. JE posted. Routing to Accounting. Closing FIN-1189 once customer confirms.
hana (Finance): Thanks all.
